name: Coffin House

dates.altered: Cross-wing added on the north-east side in 1713 (dendrochronology, per Wikipedia); legally divided into two dwellings in 1785.
dates.note: Traditionally dated 1654 by Joshua Coffin (1845); the Oxford Tree-Ring Laboratory's 2002 reading, cited by Wikipedia, has the original timbers felled in the winters of 1676-77 and 1677-78. The HABS cover calls it the 'Coffyn House'.
